name: Coinbase x402 + x402 Bazaar + Agentic Wallet (CDP)
tagline: Open HTTP-402 stablecoin payment standard, public Bazaar discovery index, and an agent wallet (CLI/MCP) that pays any x402 service
status_notes: Active. x402 is now governed by the x402 Foundation (LF Projects). Not an aggregator: each merchant sets price; no shared provider accounts. Agentic Wallet launched Feb 11, 2026.
categories: open marketplace: any x402 resource (data, AI, crypto, media, etc.)

pricing.notes: Prices set per resource by merchant; Bazaar indexes resources settled via the CDP Facilitator.

payment_rails: USDC/stablecoins on EVM chains (Base) and Solana via x402

spend_controls.notes: Agentic Wallet 'built-in security guardrails'; press reports session caps and per-transaction ceilings, enclave-held keys, KYT screening (secondary sources). MCP mode can only discover and pay, not send/trade.

setup_steps_to_first_call: Sign in and fund wallet with USDC
Discover service via Bazaar search (no key)
Request → HTTP 402 → wallet pays → retry gets resource
strengths: Open standard, zero protocol fee, self-hostable facilitator/middleware
Largest discovery index (86k+ resources) with quality signals (30-day call volume, unique payers)
Price known from the 402 challenge before paying
Distribution: Coinbase wallet + MCP for Claude/Codex/Gemini
weaknesses: No curated provider accounts — mainstream APIs (Apollo, Exa, ElevenLabs) only if someone wraps them in x402
Spend-control details mainly from secondary press

sources.claim: Bazaar public discovery, search ranking & quality, CDP SDK functions
Agentic Wallet CLI/MCP, setup commands, MCP pays only
Zero protocol fees; chains; open standard; LF Projects
Launch Feb 11, 2026; session caps / per-tx ceilings; KYT; enclave keys
